faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes GLA250 use?
faqLeft.a: It depends on the year. Early X156 models (roughly 2013–2016) use the M270 2.0-litre petrol. Later X156 models (around 2017–2020) use the M282 1.3-litre petrol. The H247 generation from 2020 uses the M260 2.0-litre petrol or the M282 1.3-litre petrol — we confirm your exact engine by registration.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes GLA250 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200, for all engine codes. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my GLA250?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm whether you have the M270, M282 or M260 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M270 GLA250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard on every M270 rebuild.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M282 GLA250 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. The M282 is fully covered — timing chains, bearings and gaskets are replaced as standard.

faqRight.q: Do you rebuild M260 GLA250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes. The M260 is the most recent unit in the GLA250 range, and we rebuild it to the same standard, replacing timing chains, bearings and gaskets.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used GLA250 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my GLA250 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a GLA250 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your car arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most GLA250 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.
